sample_unit: questions (each submitted to 6 chatbots in 2 languages over 7 days)

links.outcome: Chatbot response readability, quality, and reliability differences across English and Turkish
links.effect: Significant differences between chatbots in readability, GQS, and JAMA in both languages (p<0.05); Perplexity most difficult to read in both languages, ChatGPT most readable. Quality leaders differed by language.
links.quote: Readability, GQS, and JAMA assessments revealed statistically significant differences between the chatbots in both English and Turkish responses (p < 0.05).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the readability, quality, and reliability of six LLM chatbots answering questions on vital pulp therapy in English vs. Turkish, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
